summary: This project is a small statistics helper (`src/`).

sites.spec: `median(xs)` returns the middle value of `xs` sorted in ascending order; for an even count it is the mean of the two middle values; an empty list gives 0; `xs` is not modified.

`percentile(xs, p)` returns the nearest-rank percentile: sort ascending and take the element at position `ceil(p / 100 * n)` counting from 1 (at least the first element); an empty list gives 0; `xs` is not modified.
`histogram(xs, width)` counts values per bucket of size `width`: `x` belongs to the bucket starting at `floor(x / width) * width`; it returns an object from each non-empty bucket start to its count.
`countInRange(xs, lo, hi)` returns how many values are at least `lo` and below `hi`.
